name: Emerald Leisures Limited
about: Emerald Leisures Limited provides rooms, food and beverage, and banquet services in India. The company operates club and sports complex. It offers various facilities, such as gym, swimming pool, squash, badminton, table tennis, carrom, and chess lounges. The company also provides spa and salon, billiards and snooker, card room, library, and kiddie's corners, as well as offers hospitality services. In addition, it offers banquet and event spaces, indoor games, and boutique accommodation services. The company was formerly known as Apte Amalgamations Limited. Emerald Leisures Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Mumbai, India.
